package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"golang.org/x/sync/errgroup"
)

// scenario for errgroup_fanout_without_limit_in_handler: errgroup goroutine fanout without a visible concurrency limit in handlers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
func handlerFanout(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	urls := r.URL.Query()["url"]
	var g errgroup.Group
	for _, url := range urls {
		url := url
		g.Go(func() error {
			resp, err := http.Get(url)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			resp.Body.Close()
			return nil
		})
	}
	if err := g.Wait(); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"fetched":true}`))
}
